At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with sales operations teams:

Sales operations
  Delegated: Qualify an inbound opportunity, prepare a proposal and record the agreed follow-up in the CRM.
  Stays with you: A commercial owner approves negotiated terms and outreach outside the agreed permission.
  Exception: A prospective customer asks for a non-standard discount.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.
